# Lifecycle against the engine fixture: a real Store, Controller and
# EnvironmentService handler with a MODELED runtime on target "modeled".
# env-id is the requested fixture hook (CLI-P4 PROPOSAL-4 §3).

env-domain D
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f web.yaml --request-id web-1 --request-domain $D
stderr '^request-domain: '$D'$'
stderr '^request-id: web-1$'
stdout ' web +modeled +present +creating +0 +0$'
env-id E web

env-reconcile
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $E
stdout '^'$E' +web +modeled +present +ready +0 +0$'
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env list
stdout '^'$E' +web '

skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env exec $E -- echo hi
stdout '^echo hi$'
! stderr .

# Plan records nothing: the records are unchanged and its name stays free.
env-records before.txt
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env plan -f db.yaml
stdout '^support: supported$'
stdout '^artifacts: not-applicable$'
env-records after.txt
cmp before.txt after.txt
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f db.yaml --request-id db-1 --request-domain $D
stdout ' db +modeled +present +creating '

# After a restart the same pair replays the same environment.
env-restart
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f web.yaml --request-id web-1 --request-domain $D
stdout '^'$E' +web +modeled +present +ready '

# Delete latches absent intent; deleted follows observed cleanup.
! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env delete $E
stderr 'deletion requires --yes'
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env delete $E --yes
stdout '^'$E' +web +modeled +absent +deleting '
env-reconcile
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $E
stdout '^'$E' +web +modeled +absent +deleted '
! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env exec $E -- echo hi
stderr 'exec outcome unknown; it was not resent'

-- web.yaml --
name: web
target: modeled
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1048576
port: 8080
-- db.yaml --
name: db
target: modeled
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1048576
